AUTOSHUTDOWN.TITLE: Auto-Shutdown
AUTOSHUTDOWN.ENABLED_DOC: Turn on to automatically shut down Volumio after a set period of inactivity.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.INACTIVE_TIME_DOC: Number of minutes of inactivity before shutting down.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.CHECK_INTERVAL_DOC: How often to check for player and audio status.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.SOUND_CARD_DOC: Select the active sound card to monitor for audio playback status (PCM status).
AUTOSHUTDOWN.SHUTDOWN_METHOD_DOC: Select how the system is powered off.
AUTOSHUTDOWN.TOAST_SAVE_MSG: Auto-shutdown settings have been successfully applied.
